title: DecisionRecord
description: One answered question of a decision (ADR 0121): what was decided, with which probability, by which model, which transition followed, and what was observed afterwards. Calibration is measured from these records, never declared.

run_id.description: The run that answered; `null` for a work item's routing (`source: router`), which happens before any run (ADR 0123).

step.description: The state the step ran from.

source.description: `decision_model`: a decision step's answer; `agent`: the `confidence` an agent declared (ADR 0106), recorded to be measured on the same footing; `router`: the decision model that routed a work item at its birth (ADR 0116, ADR 0123), with `step: routing` and `question: workflow`.

transition.description: The state the workflow went to after the step, once known.

outcome.description: What was observed after the decision; each field is filled in when it becomes known.

overridden.description: A later human step on the work item contradicted the decision; for a routing, the workflow a person re-routed it to, or the one it ended in, is not the one the model answered (ADR 0123).

reopened.description: The work item came back after it ended.
